P1Harmony's 'BLOW UP' Secures Two-Week Run on Billboard 200

The dynamic boy group continues their global ascent as their 10th mini-album maintains strong momentum in the US market.

BY HALLYUZINE SEOUL DESK • NOV 25, 2026
THE DOSSIER: KEY FACTS BRIEFING
  • Album Release: 10th mini-album titled 'BLOW UP'
  • Chart Achievement: Successfully charted on the US Billboard 200 for two consecutive weeks
  • Global Impact: Highlights P1Harmony's rapidly expanding international fandom and mainstream appeal

A Steadfast Global Presence

P1Harmony continues to carve out a formidable space for themselves on the international music landscape. Their latest musical offering, the 10th mini-album 'BLOW UP', has officially secured its position on the prestigious US Billboard 200 chart for a remarkable two consecutive weeks. This sustained charting is a testament to the group's growing resonance with global listeners, proving that their appeal extends far beyond initial release-week excitement.

Defining the 'BLOW UP' Era

Marked by boundary-pushing soundscapes, high-energy performances, and distinct conceptual styling, 'BLOW UP' represents a maturation of P1Harmony's signature identity. The mini-album showcases the members' versatility as both performers and musical architects, seamlessly blending intense hip-hop rhythms with melodic hooks that cater effortlessly to international streaming audiences and avid physical album collectors alike.

The Road Ahead for P1Harmony

As P1Harmony maintains their strong footing on major global charts, the K-pop scene watches closely as the group transitions from rising contenders to established global powerhouses. With international tours, expanding promotional footprints, and a fiercely dedicated fandom backing their every move, this milestone on the Billboard 200 is merely another chapter in what is shaping up to be a defining era for the dynamic sextet.
